convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'simple_trading_system' custom indicator (unknown implementation), plus external #include <TradeAlgorithms.mqh> library providing BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose/LoadHistory/GlobalVariableDel_/CIsNewBar helpers. Custom indicator logic is opaque and must be manually reimplemented in Python.

derived_values.name: UpSignal (buy arrow)
derived_values.used_by: entry rule long / exit rule short

derived_values.name: DnSignal (sell arrow)
derived_values.used_by: entry rule short / exit rule long

other_exits: Signal-based close: if BuyPosClose enabled and DnValue signal appears, close long; if SellPosClose enabled and UpValue signal appears, close short. Additionally, historical bar scan (bars > SignalBar) checks for prior opposite signal to confirm close.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum: FREEMARGIN=0, BALANCE=1, LOSSFREEMARGIN=2, LOSSBALANCE=3, LOT=4. Default LOT means fixed lot sizing at MM=0.1.

custom_logic_notes: 1. The EA calls iCustom(Symbol(), InpInd_Timeframe, 'simple_trading_system', MAShift=4, MAPeriod=2, MAType=MODE_EMA, MAPrice=PRICE_CLOSE) — the indicator source is NOT available, so buffer semantics (which bar gets an arrow) are unknown. 2. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides CIsNewBar class for new-bar detection, plus BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose wrappers that handle position counting, margin calc, and order sending. 3. When both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose are enabled, the EA scans historical bars beyond SignalBar to find a prior opposite signal before allowing a close — this is a confirmation mechanism. 4. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are input booleans allowing independent toggling of each direction's entry and exit. 5. ATR_Period=15 is used only for min_rates_total calculation (sufficient-bars guard), not as a trading indicator. 6. Signal bar parameter defaults to 1 (previous completed bar).
backtest_data_needs: Any symbol H6 730 days (symbol unspecified in EA, uses Symbol() at runtime)
python_conversion_notes: 1. Must reverse-engineer or locate the 'simple_trading_system' custom indicator to understand its buffer logic. The indicator likely computes a MA crossover with shift and plots arrows in buffers 0 (sell) and 1 (buy). Given params: EMA period 2 shift 4 on close, the indicator probably compares current EMA vs shifted EMA. 2. TradeAlgorithms.mqh helper functions must be reimplemented: position counting, margin-based lot sizing (5 modes), new-bar detection, order send with deviation. 3. The historical-bar close-confirmation scan (lines 130-153) must be faithfully reproduced. 4. Position sizing LOT mode is straightforward (fixed 0.1 lot), but other MarginMode options require balance/equity/free margin queries. 5. StopLoss and TakeProfit are in points (1000/2000 = 100/200 pips at 5-digit), must convert to price levels in Python.
